name: InEvent
description_en:
InEvent combines event registration, access control, mobile experiences and virtual or hybrid production, with optional onsite hardware and crew services. It can configure forms, approvals, waitlists, session bookings and attendee communications around the organizer’s workflow. A software license and a staffed event-production package are separate scope decisions.

The official pricing page offers several negotiated models rather than one universal fee. Its operational conditions matter: adding a person to the attendee list consumes a registration credit, credits expire with the subscription, and lack of renewal can lead to data deletion. A pilot should test data and entitlement behavior, not only a polished attendee screen.
description_zh:
InEvent 结合活动报名、访问控制、移动体验和线上/混合制作，并有现场硬件与人员服务，可以按主办方流程配置表单、审批、候补、场次预订和沟通。软件许可与有人负责的活动制作包是不同范围决定。

官方价格页提供多种协商模式，而非统一费用。运行条件尤其重要：加入参与者名单会消耗报名额度，额度随订阅到期，不续费可能导致数据删除。试点应核对数据和权益行为，不只看参与者界面。

core_features.explanation_en: Configure approval, waitlists, session bookings and communications.
core_features.explanation_zh: 配置批准、候补、场次预约和沟通。

core_features.explanation_en: Select software, streaming, hardware and crew scope for the event.
core_features.explanation_zh: 按活动选择软件、直播、硬件与人员范围。

en: Connect a hybrid conference registration to session access and onsite or virtual attendance.
zh: 把混合会议报名关联到场次权限及现场或线上出席。
use_cases.basis: Editorial task suggestions based on official documentation; no observed deployment.

steps.en: Agree the plan and credit/retention terms, then test one registration, session access and complete export before launch.
steps.zh: 约定方案与额度/保留条件，再测试一条报名、场次权限及完整导出。

items.en: Selection judgments and examples are documentation-based; no live workflow was tested.
items.zh: 选型判断与例子依据文档，未实测真实流程。

pricing.billing_basis: Negotiated subscription model with credits, implementation and optional hardware/services.
pricing.source_snapshot_en: Quote-based with negotiated admin/registration/event/unlimited models. Implementation required except stated waiver cases; onsite hardware and agency services scoped separately. Credits count form/direct attendee additions, expire with subscription and halt new registration when exhausted. Upgrades but no downgrades; nonrenewal deletion requires a data-exit plan.
pricing.source_snapshot_zh: 按协商的管理员/报名/活动/不限量模式询价；除所列免除条件外实施必需，现场硬件及人员另定。填表或直接加入参与者消耗额度，随订阅到期，耗尽停止新报名。可升级不可降级，不续费删除需规划数据退出。

sources.title: InEvent - Event Management Software
sources.research_notes_en: Event registration, onsite hardware, mobile app, virtual production and CRM; broad AI claims are vendor descriptions.

sources.title: Pricing - InEvent
sources.research_notes_en: Actual pricing.php: quoted per-registration/admin/event/unlimited models, implementation, credit consumption/expiry, upgrade restrictions and nonrenewal deletion.

official_check.scope: Public official documents read; no purchase, account setup, independent review, hands-on test, identity verification or publication approval.

review_notes: Official documentation describes vendor functionality, not independent evidence of reliability, adoption or outcomes.
Original English synthesis and corresponding Chinese draft; examples and fit judgments are editorial guidance.
Current public pricing is a dated snapshot; purchase conditions remain subject to vendor confirmation.

sections.title_en: Check attendee identity, permission and production scope
sections.title_zh: 核对人员身份、权限与制作范围
sections.en: For an illustrative hybrid conference, register an attendee, allocate a session and verify onsite versus virtual access. InEvent lists badge/kiosk options, a mobile app, Virtual Lobby and Live Studio. Hardware packages and agency services are separately described; a virtual software license does not establish a printer, network or crew entitlement. No stream, badge or attendee journey was tested here.
sections.zh: 例如混合会议，应报名一位参与者、分配场次，分别核对现场与线上权限。InEvent 列徽章/终端、应用、Virtual Lobby 和 Live Studio，硬件包及代理服务另列，线上软件许可不证明包含打印机、网络或人员。本文未测试直播、徽章或人员路径。

sections.title_en: Count added attendees and protect the registration window
sections.title_zh: 计算加入名单的人，并保护报名窗口
sections.en: The FAQ counts a credit when a person fills the registration form or is directly added to the attendee list; custom, wait and invitation lists do not count in that definition. Exhausted credits stop new registrations until more are purchased. New credits share the original expiry date, and payment must settle before release. Do not leave replenishment until the event’s registration rush.
sections.zh: FAQ 将填写报名或直接加入参与者名单计为一个额度，自定义、候补及邀请名单不按这一定义计量。额度耗尽后停止新报名，需增购；新额度与原订阅同时到期，付款结算后才释放。不要等报名高峰才安排补充。

sections.title_en: Confirm the pricing model and implementation charge
sections.title_zh: 确认计费模式及实施费
sections.en: The page offers per-admin, per-registration, per-event or unlimited negotiated models, while billing schedules can be monthly, quarterly or annual rather than billing after each event. Implementation is required, with limited stated waiver conditions. Upgrades are allowed, but downgrades are not; upgrading can reprice already used credits and multiple purchases. No standard amount was verified. Ask for the selected plan, credit scope, currency, hardware and services on the same quote.
sections.zh: 页面提供按管理员、报名、活动或不限量协商模式，付款计划可按月、季度或年度，不等于逐场事后结算。实施必需，仅列有限免除条件。允许升级但不允许降级，升级可能重算已用额度及多次购买。未确定标准金额，应在同一报价确认方案、额度、币种、硬件及服务。

sections.title_en: Plan the end of the subscription before launch
sections.title_zh: 上线前规划订阅结束后的数据安排
sections.en: Renewal terms distinguish equal/higher credit purchases from lower purchases and warn that all data is automatically deleted when a subscription expires without renewal. Confirm export and contract-specific retention before collecting consequential records. InEvent merits investigation for linked live/virtual operations; a one-off simple meeting may need less setup. No source license, self-hosted package, backup restoration, deletion or recovery was verified by execution.
sections.zh: 续费条款区分同等/更高额度与较低购买，并警告不续费到期自动删除全部数据。收集重要记录前，应确认导出及合同保留。需要连接线下/线上运营时可研究 InEvent，简单单次会议可能无需如此配置。本文未通过执行核实源码许可、自托管、备份恢复、删除或恢复。

research_gaps: No registration, payment, stream, kiosk, app, credit exhaustion, export, renewal or deletion was executed.
Firm amounts, selected billing model, waiver eligibility, backup/retention contract, residency, license and self-hosting require confirmation.

content_method.author: Codex (AI assistant)
content_method.method: Public primary-source research, original English editorial synthesis and Chinese translation. Hypothetical examples are not executed tests.
